name: ESLint
description: Linting for JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue, Svelte, and Astro using the project’s ESLint installation.
about: In Gode’s editor, ESLint adds lint diagnostics, quick fixes, and related code actions while you edit supported files. It runs alongside each language’s main language server, starts when such a file opens in a project, and stops when none are open. It uses the project’s own ESLint package and configuration.
